summary: @sqlite-labs/nodesql is a masquerade shim that dynamic-imports a sibling scoped dependency at load time
details: The package presents three inconsistent identities in one tarball: package.json declares the name '@sqlite-labs/nodesql' with keywords 'node' and 'sql'; the README is titled 'bare-stream' and instructs installers to run `npm i @sql-access/nods` while linking to an unrelated GitHub repository; index.js is a verbatim copy of the feross/buffer library. A single injected top-level statement in index.js — `var ins = import('@sqlite-labs/createsql');` — causes `require('@sqlite-labs/nodesql')` to dynamic-import the separately-published scoped package @sqlite-labs/createsql, which is also declared as a runtime dependency. The identity mismatch (name vs. README vs. shipped code) combined with a load-time edge into an unrelated sibling package matches a loader/lure shape whose actual payload lives in the sibling package rather than in this tarball. The behavior of @sqlite-labs/createsql is not present in this package's own code.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
